status: Shared row DISTINCT key admission implemented for ordinary, ordered and post-window execution; full audit remains open
contract: RowDistinctSet replaces the unscoped Set and WeakMap serialized ledger. Query scopes own retained keys and the directory; a shared MutableMemoryLedger admits key growth before mutation and adapts its chunk reservation to available headroom.

Per-row scopes admit JSON-safe normalization and stable-key formatting before allocation. Duplicate keys release temporary storage immediately. Serialized-size and buffered-row limits are checked before a new key is retained.

Normalization preserves existing bigint, byte-to-hex, nested data and own-field semantics. Cycles and enumerable accessor properties reject explicitly before structural scalar guards or normalization read them.
Ordinary and ordered DISTINCT now support the shared owned result collector. Window DISTINCT uses the same key owner but its broader output/input lifecycle remains open.

cases: Existing exact serialized-byte boundary with escaped Unicode and duplicates remains unchanged; cap-minus-one rejects.
Legacy normalization parity includes small/large bigint, bytes, nested undefined/null, Date enumeration, missing properties and repeated inputs.
Oversized key conversion rejects under 8 KiB; cycles and accessors reject without invoking getters. Scope release preserves an unrelated sibling reservation.
Owned ordinary/ordered DISTINCT results hold reservations until release; early streaming return releases state.
1,000 duplicate probes have the same live and peak reservation as a two-input baseline (one insertion plus one duplicate). Unique cardinality 100 to 1,000 stays below 12x peak growth.

Real Brotli Parquet fixture selects repeated text before DISTINCT and verifies one output value for both ordinary and ordered queries, over HTTP 206, ignored-Range 200 and native local Worker R2. Tests combine 64/128 MiB shared pools with 2 MiB query caps and oversized-expression failures.
Existing window DISTINCT, qualify, ordering, offset and limit behavior passes the default suite.
validation.correctedTestAssumption: A one-input baseline omits duplicate formatting scratch overlapping the retained first key. The scaling test uses a two-input baseline rather than asserting those distinct lifetimes have identical peaks.

reservationMeasurements.conditions: Node 24.18.1 compiled modules; 16 MiB pool; rows {value: six-digit index} or repeated same. Measurements are tracked reservations, not heap. Elapsed timings under concurrent test load are intentionally not used as performance evidence.

limits: No CPU throughput speedup is claimed; normalization admission and mutable output detachment add work.
Window input/output buffers and projection, borrowed reference selection, hive augmentation, partition merging, source adapter allocations and remaining scalar internals remain open.
Reservations do not certify total runtime heap or production Cloudflare memory enforcement.
Full final release gates, including coverage/reference, must still be refreshed on the final implementation.
